prompts.entrance: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the user's visual reference for a Korean rhythm game title. Create the architectural BACKGROUND/FRAME layer for this exact kind of close welcoming doorway composition. Match its warm crimson/plum, honey gold, dark timber, pale glowing paper and cherry-blossom pixel-art mood. Landscape 16:9, full canvas (no letterboxing). Preserve the compelling composition: big elegant cream parchment title plaque centered across the upper beam, restrained ornamental gold edging, plum drapery at upper sides, Korean timber pillars, glimpses of blossom garden at far sides, large low drum and rolled scrolls at lower left, a modest rack of bamboo practice sticks at lower right, pink blossoms in lower foreground corners, warm sunbeams on threshold. ALL of these are STATIC scenery in this layer. CRITICAL changes for game layering: Remove BOTH central sliding door leaves entirely, leaving a clean genuinely TRANSPARENT RECTANGULAR APERTURE bounded at x=26% to74%, y=33% to84%. No colored haze, no contents, no door handles in aperture. Remove the hanging glowing lanterns entirely, leave small hooks only; our existing animated lantern sprites will be added separately. The large upper cream title plaque must be BLANK with NO LETTERS; our own brush text will be placed over it. No UI buttons, no click instruction, no option cog, no music-note symbols, no words anywhere. Crisp detailed hand-painted pixel art, restrained cohesive shapes, avoid excessive tiny ornaments. The exterior architecture, garden slivers, floor and corner blossoms remain opaque; only central aperture alpha. Output one transparent PNG frame layer.

prompts.lesson: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: static far-background layer for a layered 16:9 Unity Korean rhythm-game tutorial room. Primary request: beautiful welcoming Joseon Korean hanok TEACHING ALCOVE, an intimate beginner's lesson space, NOT a grand symmetric dojo hall. Crisp hand-painted pixel-art game background with readable pixel clusters, ink-dark edges, warm cream paper walls, honey timber, muted teal-green details and soft morning sunlight. Wide three-quarter side-on camera: left third is an open veranda overlooking a small bamboo courtyard and stone garden; right third has a low wall of neatly arranged cubbies, a few rolled scrolls, simple practice bamboo sticks and stacked straw cushions, a shallow raised teaching platform; center is a CLEAR wide tatami/straw practice mat with two subtly marked standing circles, extending across the lower middle. A blank cream-paper teaching chart is fixed high on back wall at upper right, small simple ink rhythm dots only, absolutely no words or letters. Upper center is a quiet light wall and timber crossbeam, enough uncluttered space for a separately overlaid mode title. A low writing desk and inkstone near back right, asymmetrical depth and strong left daylight make this unmistakably a small classroom, not a performance stage. Keep the midground at x25-75%, y45-80% free and unobstructed so our EXISTING separately animated student, teacher, wooden training dummy and freestanding scroll can be placed there. No humans, no characters, no dummy, no freestanding scroll stand, no UI, no text, no lantern hanging in foreground, no ornate repetitive gold trim. Floor meets back wall around 60% image height. Pixel-art warmth and clarity, selective detail, calm visual order. Landscape 16:9.
